name: nihaisha
tagline_zh: 问伤寒、翻医案、查八纲，倪海厦课程资料随问随答。连梁冬对话和斯坦福演讲都收录，不止条文，还有他讲课时的原话语气。
tagline_en: Ask about Shang Han Lun, browse clinical cases, check Bagang—Ni Haisha's course archive at your fingertips, even.
desc_en: Use this skill when the user asks about Ni Haisha / 倪海厦 TCM course material, especially Shang Han Lun / 伤寒论, Jingui / 金匮要略, Zhongjing Xinfa / 仲景心法, clinical cases / 临床案例 / 倪师医案, Bagang Bianzheng / 八纲辨证, Fuyang Forum / 扶阳论坛, Yijinjing / 易筋经, Liang Dong dialogue / 梁冬对话倪师, Stanford lecture / 斯坦福大学演讲, Tianji / 天纪 / 易经 / 阳宅 / 紫微斗数, Huangdi Neijing / 黄帝内经, Shennong Bencao / 神农本草, acupuncture / 针灸, merid
why_zh: 同类只给条文，它连倪师讲课的语气和案例语境都保留，检索直达原话，像带着老师随堂答疑。
why_en: Others give bare text; this keeps Ni's tone and case context, searching straight to his original words—like having the teacher.
